sections.label: Head
Eyes
sections.text:
Vision dim; black specks before. Lids red.
Sensation as if there were fat on the eyes.

sections.label: Mouth
sections.text:
Tearing, twisting pain in teeth down to
lower jaw. Full of saliva; feels sticky; bitter taste.

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text: Hungry all the time. Pain across

sections.label: stomach
sections.text:
Pain in stomach alternates with pain in
throat and spine, extends to chest with belching. Fixed
pain in left hypochoridrium, as if parts were being
twisted. Palpitation with stomach pains.

sections.label: Abdomen
sections.text:
Pain in lower abdomen, extending to
genitals, rectum and coccyx; better, sitting.

sections.label: Rectum
sections.text:
Frequent desire for stool. Obstinate con-
stipation in children, [Alumina; Nyctanthes,] Chronic
constipation, with haemorrhoids' and continual urging
to stool, without result.

570

sections.label: Female
sections.text:
Menses too late, black, abundant. Milky
leucorrhoea. Nipples pain when touched, as if sore in-
side. Stabbing pain in mons veneris. Very hot urine
with burning pains in vulva.

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Pain in spine extending to inguinal
region and in both loins, when ascending the stairs.
Feeling of electric shocks in all joints. Wrenching
pain in calves, extending into toes, in joints. Feet
swollen with tearing in ankles and soles.

sections.label: Skin
sections.text:
Burns, even of third degree, with slough-
ing and sepsis. Wash with sterile water and dry and
spray with paraffine, and cover with thin layer of cot-
ton. Useful also in frost bites.
